notes: No transmitter: «لَمَّا أَنْزَلَ اَللَّهُ ... قَالَ اَلنَّبِيُّ» is the Prophet's words alone, so there is no isnad (rule 10).
Rule 11: a Prophet's report with no transmitter needs a ruling. Correspondences (Ibadi, Ibn Majah) are not used.
